title: Definitions.
officialText:
The following words and terms shall for the purposes of this section have the meanings shown herein.
*LARGE WIND TURBINE. A turbine with a swept area greater than 200 m².
*LARGE WIND TURBINE TOWER. A structure that supports a large wind turbine.
*Section 3114.2 was added by Local Law 98 of 2019. This law has an effective date of November 15, 2019.
